input.new_string:
"""Browser authentication-state boundary."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import hmac
import secrets
import time


def create_browser_auth_state(user_id: str, secret: str) -> dict[str, object]:
    if not user_id:
        raise ValueError("user_id is required")
    if not secret:
        raise ValueError("secret is required")

    issued_at = int(time.time())
    session_token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    signature = hmac.new(
        secret.encode("utf-8"),
        f"{user_id}:{session_token}:{issued_at}".encode("utf-8"),
        hashlib.sha256,
    ).hexdigest()

    return {
        "user_id": user_id,
        "session_token": session_token,
        "issued_at": issued_at,
        "signature": signature,
    }
